limitations: Source tests use fixture provider answers and paired book observations; none are production fallback data or hosted efficacy evidence.

Observation consumes real terminal owner packets containing harness_observation facts bound to the adopted version, the first ten distinct owner trading dates and fixed net-of-costs criterion. It does not implement a counterfactual book producer. A deployment without this source extension records a refusal and keeps the experiment active.
The inherited shadow evaluator still requires its dedicated deny-all replay provider and live isolation probe supplied by its caller.
Observation review and outbox recovery are Persona-owner operations; no new scheduler, credential, privileged cross-plane capability or deployment is introduced.

Missing service URL/token, failed delivery, or an unbound receipt leaves a pending durable intent with an error. Replay attempts at most four intents per owner call. Pending is not publication success.
Outside-paper and hurt outcomes only propose to governance. Operator approval and execution are not claimed; risk, capital, lifecycle, live and trade authority remain unchanged.
